stem_book: Which of the following graphs is the graph of a function? (a) graph (A) (b) graph (B) (c) graph (C) (d) graph (D)
reason: Options are drawings (A sideways parabola, B circle, C step graph, D loop curve) — use the figure
work: Vertical-line test: parabola x = y², circle and the loop each cut twice; the step graph (one filled end per step) passes
